title: Workmanship Replacement Posting — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty
content:
## Posting a workmanship replacement — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty

When a Crestline store finds one tire of an active Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty set defective at a tread inspection and replaces it at that visit, the replacement is posted to the set as a workmanship replacement entry for that wheel position, citing the inspection entry that recorded the manufacturing defect, together with the workmanship share charged to the customer (0.00 when the replacement is free). The replacement tire stays on the same set.

### Capability
`record_workmanship_replacement_cc1528ea` posts to a customer's tire set the workmanship replacement of one defective tire that a Crestline store made at an inspection visit. One call books one workmanship replacement entry for the wheel position, dated the inspection visit, citing that inspection and carrying its odometer, the replacing store, the defect and the customer's share charged. Once booked, the set's history shows the replacement entry with its share.

### Invocation
An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `record_workmanship_replacement_cc1528ea` and then calls it.

### Parameters
| Parameter | Meaning and format |
|---|---|
| `tire_set_id` | reference number of the tire set the defective tire belongs to, as returned by the tire set lookup |
| `source_tire_event_id` | reference number of the tread inspection entry that found the defect, as returned by the tire activity history lookup |
| `store_id` | reference number of the Crestline store that replaced the tire, as returned by the store lookup |
| `tire_position` | wheel position replaced; enum `LF` left front, `RF` right front, `LR` left rear, `RR` right rear, `SP` a matching full-size spare that is part of the set; `ALL` is never a replaced position and applies only to whole-set services |
| `defect_code` | manufacturing defect found; enum `tread_separation` (tread separating from the casing), `out_of_round` (tire out of round), `belt_shift` (an internal belt has shifted), `bead_leak` (the bead will not seal on a sound wheel); `none` is never recorded on a replacement and applies only to entries without a defect |
| `charge_amount` | share charged to the customer for the replacement, USD, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent; 0.00 when the replacement is free |

### Return
A receipt with `tire_event_id` (reference number of the replacement entry), `tire_set_id`, `tire_position`, `defect_code` and `charge_amount` (USD share charged). A returned `tire_event_id` means the replacement was posted.
